condition: Atrial fibrillation on warfarin, high INR

patient_persona.description: Mak Cik Fatimah binti Daud, 68, female, retired rubber estate worker from Teluk Intan, Perak; on warfarin for atrial fibrillation. Soft, worried voice, Perak Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Goh Wei Siang, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, pharmacist-led anticoagulation clinic doctor at a Teluk Intan hospital. Calm and methodical; English-leaning, clear Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mak cik, INR hari ni 4.2. Target kita 2 to 3. Ada lebam-lebam atau berdarah?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada, doktor. Lengan ni lebam biru, padahal tak terhantuk apa pun. Gusi pun berdarah sikit masa gosok gigi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada apa-apa berubah dua minggu ni? Ubat baru, makan lain, demam?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Minggu lepas batuk, klinik swasta bagi antibiotic, lupa nama. Lepas tu anak bagi jamu untuk sendi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh saya tengok ubat tu? Ah, clarithromycin. Ubat ni memang boleh naikkan INR, because it blocks warfarin breakdown in the liver.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jamu tu pun kita tak tahu kandungan dia. Some herbal products ada effect pada darah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Habis tu, mak cik kena buat apa sekarang?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Malam ni tak payah makan warfarin, skip one dose. Esok sambung dengan dos biasa, 3mg.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jamu tu stop dulu, and next time jumpa doktor, beritahu yang mak cik makan warfarin. Tunjuk buku kuning ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Buku kuning ni kena tunjuk setiap kali?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, setiap kali, termasuk doktor gigi dan farmasi. Kita check INR balik hari Isnin.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau berdarah banyak macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau kencing merah, berak hitam, muntah darah, atau sakit kepala teruk tiba-tiba, terus pergi emergency.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Mak cik takut juga ni.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa, kita dah tangkap awal. Dengan INR 4.2 tanpa pendarahan besar, cukup skip satu dos dan monitor.

condition: Atrial fibrillation, new diagnosis, starting apixaban

patient_persona.description: Mr. Chong Kwai Fook, 76, male, retired hardware shop owner in Kepong, Kuala Lumpur; palpitations for a month, hypertensive. Precise, slightly suspicious, Cantonese-flavoured Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nurul Izzah binti Zakaria, Malay woman in her 40s, cardiologist at a Kuala Lumpur hospital. Clear, patient; English with Mandarin phrases she learnt in practice, patient replies in Mandarin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Chong, your ECG shows atrial fibrillation. 心跳不规则，上面的心房乱跳，not beating properly.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 这个危险吗？我只是觉得心跳很乱，有时候喘。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The main danger is stroke. 血在心房里面流得慢，会形成 blood clot，跑到脑就中风。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your score, CHA2DS2-VASc, is 3, because of your age and high blood pressure. 所以要吃 blood thinner.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我朋友吃 warfarin，每个月都要抽血，很麻烦。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Not warfarin. I'll give you apixaban 5mg, twice a day, 早上一粒, 晚上一粒. No need for monthly INR test.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那个会不会出血很厉害？我刷牙有时候会流血。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Some bleeding risk, yes. 但是预防中风的好处比风险大很多。Gum bleeding a little is okay, but tell me if it's heavy.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我还有吃银杏，ginkgo，说对脑好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Please stop the ginkgo. 跟 apixaban 一起吃，出血的风险会增加。Also avoid painkillers like ibuprofen.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For the palpitations, bisoprolol 2.5mg in the morning, to slow the heart rate. Heart rate now 118.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我还要做什么检查？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Echo of the heart and thyroid blood test. 甲状腺太活跃也会引起 AF.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，我明白了。Apixaban 早晚各一粒，不要漏。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Correct. 如果漏吃，六个钟头内记得就吃，超过了就等下一次，don't double.

condition: Atrial fibrillation on rivaroxaban, dose review after a fall

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Grace Devadason, 78, female, retired music teacher in Petaling Jaya, Malaysian Indian Christian; lives with her son. Clear, gentle voice, proper English with occasional Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Amirul Hakim bin Zainuddin, Malay man in his 30s, medical officer at a PJ hospital geriatric clinic. Courteous, careful; English with a little Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mrs. Devadason, your son said you had a fall last week. Are you hurt anywhere?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Just a bruise on my hip, doctor. I slipped in the bathroom, lantai licin. I was more embarrassed than hurt.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Did you hit your head? Any headache, vomiting or confusion since then?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, I landed on my bottom. Tak ada headache at all.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. I've checked your blood test. Your kidney function has dropped, creatinine clearance about 40.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: So your rivaroxaban should be reduced from 20mg to 15mg, once a day with dinner.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lower dose, is that still enough to prevent stroke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, 15mg is the correct dose for your kidneys. Too high a dose increases bleeding, especially if you fall again.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Should I stop the blood thinner, since I might jatuh again? My son worries.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Most experts say no. You'd need to fall very many times a year before the bleeding risk outweighs the stroke risk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Instead, let's make falls less likely. Anti-slip mat, grab bar in the bathroom, and a night light.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: That's sensible. Also, the dentist wants to pull out one tooth next month.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For one tooth, usually no need to stop. Take it in the evening as usual, and the dentist can use local measures. Ask him to call us if unsure.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih, doctor. You've explained it very kindly.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: My pleasure. The physio will also see you today for balance exercises. Jumpa lagi in three months.

condition: Atrial fibrillation, low INR and leafy vegetables

patient_persona.description: Pak Cik Che Mat bin Che Hassan, 64, male, retired lorry driver from Kota Bharu, Kelantan; on warfarin for three years. Cheerful, loud, Kelantanese dialect words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Wong Pei Shan, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, medical officer at a Kota Bharu hospital anticoagulation clinic. Friendly and patient; English-leaning, good Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pak cik, INR hari ni 1.5, rendah. Last time 2.4. Ada tertinggal warfarin?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak, doktor. Makan tiap-tiap malam. Isteri kawal.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Makan pula macam mana? Any green leafy vegetables, ulam?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ha, ada! Bulan ni kampung banyak pucuk ubi, ulam raja. Isteri masak tiap-tiap hari. Sedap gapo.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Itulah dia. Sayur hijau ni banyak vitamin K, dan vitamin K lawan kesan warfarin. So darah jadi pekat balik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kena berhenti makan ulam la ni?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak payah berhenti. Yang penting consistent, sama banyak setiap hari. Jangan satu minggu banyak, minggu lain tak ada.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For now, warfarin kita naikkan sikit, dari 4mg ke 4.5mg. Check INR balik dua minggu lagi.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, anak saya cakap ada ubat baru tak perlu check darah. Betul ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Betul, DOAC macam apixaban atau dabigatran. Tak kacau dengan makanan, tak perlu INR.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Boleh tukar? Saya penat ulang-alik hospital.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your kidney function is good, so boleh consider. Tapi di sini dia bukan ubat standard, mungkin kena beli sendiri, sekitar RM200 sebulan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Mahal tu, doktor. Pencen saya tak cukup.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Faham. Kalau macam tu, kita teruskan warfarin, dan kita cuba stabilkan dengan makanan yang konsisten.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik la. Nanti saya suruh isteri masak ulam sikit-sikit tiap hari, jangan banyak sekaligus.

patient_persona.description: Ms. Tiong Siew Ling, 55, female, travel agency owner in Kuching, Sarawak; episodes of racing heart, drinks coffee heavily. Fast, animated, mixes English and Mandarin constantly.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Abang Mohd Firdaus bin Abang Ahmad, Sarawakian Malay man in his 40s, cardiologist at a Kuching hospital. Friendly, clear; English-leaning, some Mandarin and Sarawak Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ms. Tiong, your 24-hour Holter 结果出来了. It captured two episodes of atrial fibrillation, each about forty minutes.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 真的？那天晚上我确实觉得心跳很乱。So is it serious?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's paroxysmal AF, 会自己来，自己停. The good news is your heart structure on echo is normal.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那为什么会这样？I'm not even that old.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Common triggers are alcohol, too much caffeine, poor sleep, stress. 你一天喝几杯 kopi?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Honestly, 四杯 kopi-O kaw, sometimes five. Business very busy, no coffee cannot survive.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's quite a lot. Try to cut down to one or two cups. 酒呢? Any alcohol?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Weekend 会喝 wine 两三杯 with clients. Weekday 没有.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Binge drinking on weekends is a known trigger, we call it holiday heart. Better limit to one glass.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For stroke risk, your score is 1, because you are female only. 所以现在不需要吃 blood thinner.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 太好了！I was so scared I need to take medicine forever.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For symptoms, I'll give bisoprolol 1.25mg once a day. If palpitations come and don't stop after an hour, go to the emergency.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, noted. 那我可以继续去 gym 吗?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, exercise is good for AF. Also get your sleep checked, 因为你说你打鼾很大声.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我老公每天投诉. OK doctor, I'll do a sleep study. Terima kasih!

patient_persona.description: Encik Hashim bin Latif, 57, male, lorry dispatcher from Kajang, Selangor; left arm went weak for twenty minutes yesterday. Tense voice, worried, speaks quickly.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ng Siew Hong, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, emergency physician at a Kajang hospital. Calm, focused; English with simple Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Hashim, cerita balik apa jadi semalam. Pukul berapa?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lebih kurang pukul empat petang. Tengah minum teh, tiba-tiba tangan kiri lemah, cawan jatuh. Mulut rasa senget sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Berapa lama lemah tu? And bercakap masa tu macam mana, pelat tak?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dalam dua puluh minit, lepas tu hilang terus. Isteri kata cakap saya pelat sikit masa tu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sekarang saya check kekuatan dan muka encik semua normal. What you had is a TIA, transient ischaemic attack. Macam amaran untuk stroke.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Amaran? Maksudnya saya akan kena stroke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Risiko stroke dalam minggu pertama selepas TIA agak tinggi. That's why kita kena bertindak cepat hari ni.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tekanan darah encik 172 over 98 tadi. Encik ada darah tinggi, kencing manis?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Darah tinggi ada, tapi dah setahun tak makan ubat. Rasa sihat je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's likely the main cause. Hari ni kita buat CT brain, ECG, blood test, and carotid Doppler scan of the neck vessels.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya mulakan aspirin dan clopidogrel together for 21 days, then clopidogrel saja. Atorvastatin 40mg pun start malam ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Boleh saya balik rumah lepas ni?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kami nak admit encik semalam dua untuk observe dan buat semua scan. Kalau lemah balik, kami boleh bertindak cepat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, doktor. Saya call isteri dulu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh. Dan mulai sekarang, ubat darah tinggi mesti makan setiap hari, even if you feel fine.

patient_persona.description: Madam Soh Kim Lan, 70, female, retired market vegetable seller in Kluang, Johor; left-sided ischaemic stroke three months ago, mild right-hand weakness. Slightly slow speech, determined.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Rajesh a/l Pillai, Malaysian Indian man in his 40s, rehabilitation physician at a Johor hospital. Encouraging, patient; English with Mandarin phrases and Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 苏婆婆，三个月了。你的右手现在怎样？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 比以前好一点。可以拿汤匙了，可是扣纽扣还是很难，写字也不行。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这是 fine motor skill，最慢恢复的。你有每天做 physiotherapy 的运动吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有啊，每天早上捏那个软球，捏一百下。我女儿监督我。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 很好，continue. Occupational therapist 也会教你扣纽扣和用筷子的技巧。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的血压今天 128 over 78，很好。Amlodipine 和 perindopril 要继续。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我还在吃 clopidogrel 和 atorvastatin，要吃到什么时候？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这两种是长期的，不能停。Clopidogrel 防止血块，atorvastatin 让血管稳定。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我最近心情很不好，常常哭，觉得自己没用。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 谢谢你讲出来。中风后很多人会有 depression，大概三分之一。这是脑受伤的一部分，不是你的错。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我会介绍你见 counsellor，也可以考虑吃一点药，比如 sertraline。你愿意吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 愿意，我不想每天哭，女儿也很辛苦。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我们一起来. Are you still going to the pasar? 你还有去巴刹吗?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我女儿带我去，我坐在旁边看。以前我自己卖菜几十年的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 慢慢来。Physio 做得好，六个月后很多人可以恢复更多。下次 clinic 三个月后。

patient_persona.description: Mr. Anthony de Costa, 63, male, retired fisherman and boat repairer from the Portuguese Settlement, Melaka; Malaysian Eurasian, smoker. Warm, gravelly voice, Malaysian English with Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chitra a/p Ramachandran, Malaysian Indian woman in her 40s, neurologist at a Melaka hospital. Crisp and kind; English with some Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. de Costa, you mentioned your right eye went dark last Thursday. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Morning, I was fixing my boat. Suddenly my right eye, like somebody pulled a curtain down. Gelap terus. After five minutes, came back.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Only the right eye? Any weakness, numbness, or trouble talking?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Only the eye, doctor. The rest all okay. I thought maybe just penat lah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: This is called amaurosis fugax, a type of TIA affecting the eye. It's often from the carotid artery in the neck.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your carotid Doppler shows a 75 percent narrowing on the right side. That's significant.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Seventy-five percent blocked? Wah, that's a lot. What do we do?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: With symptoms and this much narrowing, surgery to clean out the artery, carotid endarterectomy, reduces stroke risk a lot. Best done within two weeks.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Surgery on the neck ah? Saya takut, doctor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's a common operation. The vascular surgeon at Hospital Melaka will see you this week. I'll call them today.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Meanwhile, aspirin 100mg and atorvastatin 80mg start today. And the cigarettes, you must stop now.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Forty years I hisap rokok, doctor. But okay, this one really frighten me.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. If you get any weakness, facial droop, slurred speech, or the eye goes dark again, call 999 immediately.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Understood. My isteri will make sure. Thank you, doctor.

condition: Acute stroke ward round, swallowing assessment

patient_persona.description: Puan Rosmah binti Harun, 66, female, retired school cook from Kangar, Perlis; day two after a right-sided ischaemic stroke with left-sided weakness. Slightly slurred, tired voice.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Yap Chee Wai, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, medical officer at a Kangar hospital, on the morning ward round. Gentle, patient; English with simple Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Selamat pagi, Puan Rosmah. Saya Dr. Yap. Puan dengar saya jelas?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dengar, doktor. Cakap saya pelat sikit. Tangan kiri ni berat, tak boleh angkat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa, cakap perlahan-lahan. Semalam speech therapist dah buat swallow test. Puan tersedak masa minum air.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ya, air masuk salah jalan. Batuk teruk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That means otot menelan pun terjejas. Kalau makan minum biasa, makanan boleh masuk paru-paru, cause pneumonia.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Buat sementara, kita perlu masukkan tiub dari hidung ke perut, NG tube, untuk bagi makanan dan ubat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tiub dalam hidung? Tak nak la, doktor. Mesti sakit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Masa masuk tu memang tak selesa, tapi sekejap je. Lepas tu tak sakit. Biasanya sementara, beberapa hari atau minggu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bila saya boleh makan macam biasa?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Speech therapist akan buat test semula setiap beberapa hari. Bila dah selamat, kita mula dengan bubur pekat dulu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Aspirin kita dah mula, 300mg, and your blood pressure 168 over 92, kita biarkan tinggi sikit dulu untuk hari-hari awal ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kenapa biar tinggi? Tak bahaya ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hari-hari pertama, the brain needs enough blood flow. Lepas beberapa hari baru kita turunkan perlahan-lahan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Faham, doktor. Anak saya datang tengah hari, doktor tolong cakap dengan dia.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh. Physio pun akan datang hari ni, mula gerakkan tangan dan kaki kiri puan.

condition: Stroke secondary prevention, MRI and risk factor review

patient_persona.description: Mr. Chan Fook Sang, 58, male, Hakka construction supplier in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah; lacunar stroke two months ago with mild left leg weakness. Brisk, businesslike, heavy English-Mandarin mixing, Sabah Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Noraini binti Salleh, Sabahan Malay woman in her 40s, neurologist at a Kota Kinabalu hospital. Direct and friendly; English with Malay and some Mandarin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Chan, your MRI 结果出来了. It shows a small lacunar infarct, deep in the brain. That explains the left leg weakness.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Small 是好消息 right? 我现在走路差不多 normal 了.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, recovery is good. But lacunar stroke is caused by small vessel disease, mostly from blood pressure, sugar and smoking.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我知道 lah, 我太太每天讲. So what's my numbers now?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your BP today 146 over 90, HbA1c 8.4, LDL 3.1. All three still above target.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哇, all fail 啊. 我有吃药的, but sometimes 太忙 forget.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 忘记吃药，stroke risk 就会上去. Let me simplify. I'll combine your BP pills into one tablet, perindopril-amlodipine, once a day.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For cholesterol, atorvastatin up to 80mg. Target LDL below 1.8. For sugar, 我会 refer 你去 diabetes clinic.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK can. Smoking 我已经减到一天五支 lah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Five is still too many. Even one a day increases stroke risk. 我们目标 zero, OK?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 很难, but 我试试看. Business 应酬很多人抽烟.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The quit clinic can give varenicline, it reduces cravings. Mau cuba?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Mau, mau. 我不想再中风, 下次可能不会那么好运.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Exactly. Clopidogrel 75mg continue every day. Come back in three months with your BP diary.
